profile.headline: Make miracles and Create magic | Junior Software Developer | The Tech Academy | Looking to transition into Tech
profile.summary:
After completing my undergraduate degree at the Illustrious Morgan State University,  I spent the past six years working in the Hospitality and customer service industry through various channels. I have had the chance to grow and develop strong soft skills like quick-thinking, effective communication, teamwork and leadership just to name a few. After the pandemic, I decided to challenge myself and delved into the world of programming. 

In February 2022, I decided to make a career change where I enrolled at the Tech Academy under the full-stack Software Developer program. This program has very insightful and has allowed me to learn several coding languages. As a Junior Software Developer, I enjoy finding new and creative solutions to conquer my goals. I specialize in working well in a team setting collaborating on assignments as well as producing quality independent work. 



Connect: ShalenaBailey1@gmail.com

Achievements - Certified Software Developer

Specialties
- C# and .NET Framework
- Python
- JavaScript
- HTML / CSS Front end development

positions.title: C# Developer
positions.description: Participated in a two week sprint where I was able to contribute my own creation to the overall Theater webpage. This sprint consisted of several elements that I was tasked with completing for the overall success of the project. One area that I was responsible for, was the creation of the Model and CRUD pages of the Blog Post section for the web page. I was also responsible for creating and styling a Donation page for the theater, the Home page for the Blog Post section and the Edit page for the Blog Post following a specialized color palate and design provided by the client.

positions.title: Python Developer
positions.description: Participated in a two week sprint where I was able to contribute my own creation to the overall web page. I created a functional Fitness Log app that allows an individual to track their workout and store it for later review. With this fitness app, the users are able to create new entries, modify an existing entry, as well as delete their entry from the log storage. This project allowed me to heavily utilize my knowledge of  the Python coding language as well as my knowledge of HTML/CSS coding for styling to create an aesthetically pleasing, user friendly app.
